answer: Divergent-Response Challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge derived from live environment data (an inlet sensor reading, a mesa survey coordinate, a jetty load metric) within a short window. Enforcement: identical clones cannot produce divergent responses to the same challenge without diverging behavior, which exposes the shared controller. An attacker must run and maintain a separate response pathway per identity, paying full compute and coordination cost each time rather than cloning one.
